project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child shows a planted tree or flower, explains how compost feeds the soil, recites a fruit poem, draws and colours a fruit and counts seeds up to 20.

activities.goal_en: Recite a short fruit poem with expression.
activities.prompt_en: Listen to the mango poem and say it with me.
steps_en: Say the poem with gestures.
Repeat line by line.
Say it together.
Ask: which fruit is it? what colour?
observe_en: Names the fruit and its colour.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 34 (Poetry and Rhymes: Poems), p. 61; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.story_en:
Mango, mango, on the tree,
Green today, but wait and see,
Yellow, sweet and soft one day,
We will share it, hip hooray!

activities.goal_en: Blend sounds to read simple words.
activities.prompt_en: Listen: m – a – n. Put the sounds together: man! Now try with the cards.
steps_en: Say three sounds slowly.
Blend them together to make a word.
Show letter cards for simple words (sun, pot, bag).
The child blends and reads.
observe_en: Blends the sounds into a word.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 36 (Reading: Letters of the alphabet), p. 63; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Zigzag letters and numbers: v, w, x, z, 1, 4, 7
activities.goal_en: Write letters and numbers made of straight slanted lines.
activities.prompt_en: Zig and zag! These letters have straight slanted lines: v, w, x, z. And the numbers 1, 4, 7.
steps_en: Draw the letters in the air.
Trace them in sand.
Trace them on dotted lines.
Write a row of each.
observe_en: Keeps the letters on the line.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 37 (Writing: Pre-letter formation), p. 64; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Counting fruits to ten in French
activities.goal_en: Count objects from 1 to 10 in French.
activities.prompt_en: Let us count the oranges in French: un, deux, trois… dix!
steps_en: Count 10 fruits in English.
Count them again in French.
The child counts alone, pointing.
Play shop: “Trois mangues, s’il vous plaît !”
observe_en: Uses a number in a sentence.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 38 (French: Compter), p. 65; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Count seeds up to 20 and make groups of 10.
activities.prompt_en: How many seeds? Make a group of 10 first, then count the rest.
steps_en: Put 13 to 20 seeds on the table.
Make a group of 10 in a cup.
Count on with the others.
Write the number with help.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 39 (Mathematics: Counting), p. 66–67; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: How many seeds can you see?
interactive.explanation_en: Count 10, then count on: eleven… sixteen. There are 16 seeds.

activities.goal_en: Identify sources of manure and make compost.
activities.prompt_en: Peels, leaves and grass can become food for the soil. This is compost.
steps_en: Show kitchen peels, dry leaves and grass.
Put them in a hole or a box in layers with a little soil.
Add a little water and cover.
Check it every week with gloves.
observe_en: Names things that go into compost.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 43 (Agriculture: Sources of manure), p. 76; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Mix water and powders to make a paste or a dough.
activities.prompt_en: Flour and water make dough. Soil and water make mud paste. Let us try!
steps_en: Put some flour in a bowl, add water little by little.
Mix and knead to make dough.
Do the same with soil.
Compare: what happens with too much water?
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 42 (Science and Technology: Experiments), p. 73–75; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Practise love and care for the environment by planting a tree or flowers.
activities.prompt_en: Trees give shade and clean air. Let us plant a seedling and look after it.
steps_en: Choose a place with an adult.
Dig a hole and put the seedling in.
Fill with soil and compost, then water.
Make a sign with the child’s name.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 46 (Environmental Education: Climate change), p. 79; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Choose a balanced diet with fruit and vegetables.
activities.prompt_en: A good plate has food for energy, food for growing and fruit or vegetables.
steps_en: Show pictures of foods.
Build a plate together: plantain or rice, beans or fish, vegetables.
Add a fruit for dessert.
Ask what the child ate yesterday.
observe_en: Builds a plate with three kinds of food.
Names a healthy meal from home.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 48 (Health Education and Nutrition: Good health habits), p. 81; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Recognise the common good and use public places with care.
activities.prompt_en: The public garden is for everyone. We do not pick the flowers or break the branches.
steps_en: Show a picture of a public garden or the school garden.
Ask: who does it belong to? (everyone)
List good and bad actions there.
Take care of a part of the school garden.
observe_en: Says that it belongs to everyone.
Helps to care for the garden.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 44 (Citizenship: Common good), p. 77; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Drawing a fruit and a plant
activities.goal_en: Draw and colour fruits and plants using at least two colours.
activities.prompt_en: Look at the pineapple. Draw it and colour it with yellow and green.
steps_en: Observe a real fruit or plant.
Draw the main shape.
Add details (leaves, spots).
Colour with at least two colours.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 50 (Drawing and Colouring: Drawing and colouring diverse objects), p. 83; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Passing the ball with the feet
activities.goal_en: Practise football passes and play with others fairly.
activities.prompt_en: Pass the ball to your friend with the inside of your foot. Then stop the ball!
steps_en: Show a pass with the inside of the foot.
Pass in pairs, a few steps apart.
Stop the ball with the foot.
Play a small game, passing to every player.
observe_en: Passes with the inside of the foot.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 53 (Physical Education and Sports: Team sports), p. 86; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Writes v, w, x, z and 1, 4, 7.
Plants a tree or a flower.
Draws and colours a fruit with two colours.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery Two tables, cited and not reproduced.
